title: Projection normalization of the support quotient map
statement: Let A→B be a homomorphism of finite commutative rings, j:U→P an open immersion of schemes, and L an ordinary etale A-module derived object. Let T denote derived extension of scalars, Res exact restriction of scalars, and R_A,R_B derived direct image. Assume L, TL, R_A j*L, T R_A j*L and R_B j*TL are bounded below. Choose a termwise injective K-injective complex I and an isomorphism e:Qloc(I)≅L, a flat-term K-flat coefficient resolution π:Q→B_P, and any functorial termwise injective K-injective replacement a:Q⊗I→J. Suppose j*I,j*J are K-injective. Let v:Q⊗j_*j*I→j_*j*J be the canonical open quotient map OpenSupport.rightMap of the ordinary j*⊣j_* adjunction [lem-pur-flat-support-chain-diagram], i.e. the map with the total-summand adjunct characterization IsRightMap j Q I J a [def-pur-etale-kflat-support-data]. Then Qloc(v) followed by targetThirdModel (using replacementIso a (tensorModel π e)) equals sourceThirdModel (π,e) followed by restrictedProjection. Here sourceThirdModel, targetThirdModel and restrictedProjection are the specified exact-pullback coordinate maps of [def-pur-etale-kflat-support-data]; the last map is Res(coefficientProjection) followed by the canonical scalar-restriction/direct-image map and the inverse restriction/exact-pullback isomorphism. A complementary closed immersion i and its range equality may be supplied, but are unused in this assertion.

proof.text:
apply computes_coefficient_projection to the flat-term K-flat augmentation
and the quasi-isomorphism to the chosen replacement. Transport its five lower bounds
along leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory. The ordinary adjunct is the rightMap
of the strict support diagram by the cochain adjunction formula. In the target,
naturality of the exact/left-derived comparison cancels its inverse with the
restriction/pullback comparison. In the source use naturality of tensorModel in the
representing isomorphism. Naturality of scalarMate identifies the transported
coefficient projection, and naturality of scalarRestrictionDirectImageMap moves the
remaining exact-pullback comparison past restriction/direct image. Cancelling the
specified model isomorphisms gives the displayed equality.

lean.statement:
theorem support_comparison_projection [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (i : Z ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (j : U ⟶ P) [IsOpenImmersion j] (hij : Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ)
    (L : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf P.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (_hTL : ∃ n : ℤ, ((scalarExtension φ P).obj L.obj).IsGE n)
    (_hRTL : ∃ n : ℤ, ((R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j)).obj
      ((D(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j)).obj
        ((scalarExtension φ P).obj L.obj))).IsGE n)
    (_hRL : ∃ n : ℤ, ((R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)).obj
      ((D(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)).obj L.obj)).IsGE n)
    (_hTRL : ∃ n : ℤ, ((scalarExtension φ P).obj
      ((R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)).obj
        ((D(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)).obj L.obj))).IsGE n)
    (I : Complex A P) [I.IsKInjective] [∀ n : ℤ, Injective (I.X n)]
    (e : (localize A P).obj I ≅ L.obj)
    (Q : Complex A P)
    (π : Q ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (Sheaf P.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) 0).obj (scalarCoefficientSheaf φ P))
    [QuasiIso π] (hQ : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso
      (Sheaf P.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (.up ℤ)).kFlat Q)
    (_hQf : ∀ n : ℤ, ObjectProperty.flat (Q.X n))
    (F : Complex A P ⥤ Complex A P) (η : 𝟭 _ ⟶ F)
    [∀ K : Complex A P, (F.obj K).IsKInjective]
    [∀ (K : Complex A P) (n : ℤ), Injective ((F.obj K).X n)]
    [∀ K : Complex A P, QuasiIso (η.app K)]
    (hI : CochainComplex.IsKInjective ((pullComplex A j).obj I))
    (hJ : CochainComplex.IsKInjective ((pullComplex A j).obj (F.obj (Q ⊗ I))))
    :
    let N := Q ⊗ I
    let J := F.obj N
    let a := η.app N
    let v := OpenSupport.rightMap
      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)
      Q I J a
    (localize A P).map v ≫
          (targetThirdModel φ j J L.obj
            (replacementIso a (tensorModel φ Q π hQ I L.obj e)) hJ).hom =
        (sourceThirdModel φ j Q π hQ I L.obj e hI).hom ≫ restrictedProjection φ j L.obj
